name: Florida Restaurant Equipment Professionals
old_description: Florida Restaurant Equipment Professionals provides expert solutions through sound specification and support of our family of leading quality manufacturers.
about:
Florida Restaurant Equipment Professionals, Inc. (FLREPs) operates from its headquarters in Tampa, with additional offices in Central and South Florida. The company serves as a manufacturer's representative for premium foodservice equipment brands across the state. President Steve Smith leads a team of seasoned professionals including operations, culinary, and sales specialists.

FLREPs does not manufacture equipment; instead, it represents complete product lines from multiple manufacturers, providing specification support, product expertise, and live cooking demonstrations for dealers, specifiers, and end-users. The firm's coverage spans the entire state, with territory managers and marketing chefs supporting customers from the Panhandle to the Keys.

The company focuses on the foodservice industry, serving channels that include independent restaurants, chains, institutional kitchens, and K-12 school nutrition programs. Business development manager Linda Pierce specializes in the K-12 segment, while territory sales managers cover regional accounts.

FLREPs emphasizes its relationships with channel partners and the premium brands it represents, aiming to deliver total faceted coverage and experienced product support for every aspect of the foodservice industry.
